name: 🎃 Ecos: La Brea
desc:
⛰️ Step into Ice Age North America, 25,000 years ago. In Ecos: La Brea, explore the prehistoric ecosystem preserved by the iconic La Brea Tar Pits of Los Angeles, California.

🦣 Pack together as the cunning Dire Wolf, ambush mighty prey as the Saber-tooth Cat, lock horns as the formidable Ancient Bison, gallop freely as the Western Horse, or terraform the landscape as the Columbian Mammoth. Team up with friends and learn about the diverse habitats & animals of La Brea as you play.

🎨 Icon by: @JayMD11

Tags: Animal Survival, Open World, Ice Age, RPG, Survival, Roleplay, Prehistory, Fossil, Cat, Wolf, Tiger, Lion, Horse, Saber tooth, Cenozoic, Mammoth, Elephant, Bison, Cow

llm.loop: choose a prehistoric animal -> survive, hunt or graze in an open Ice Age ecosystem -> pack with friends -> grow
llm.objectives: survive as an Ice Age animal and play with your pack
llm.progression: tracks currency, animal variants and morphs
llm.instructions: pick an animal species and survive/roleplay; mammoths terraform
unique: educational La Brea Tar Pits setting
llm.thumbnails: realistic dire wolf art, mammoth and saber-tooth hunting scenes
llm.complexity_notes: large open-world terrain, many quadruped models with custom animation, ecosystem AI
